original_snippet:
if not auth or not auth.strip().startswith("Bearer "):
        raise AuthenticationRequiredError("Missing or malformed Authorization header")
mutated_snippet:
if auth is None and False:
        raise AuthenticationRequiredError("Missing or malformed Authorization header")
description: Neutralize the missing/malformed-header guard so unauthenticated requests slip past
expected_violation: A request with a missing or malformed Authorization header is not rejected at the header guard
violation_scenario: extract_bearer_token({}) or extract_bearer_token({'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz'}) no longer raises at the header guard.
rationale: Replacing the header condition with an always-false guard removes the enforcement, and the existing missing/malformed/blank tests should catch it.
